integrity: A complete proof and a self-contained Python verifier with expected output are provided; checked homotopy dimensions and multiplicities are derived from an acyclic patchwork matching, not extrapolated from finite experiments. No independent verification or audit is claimed.
limitations: The theorem covers only the induced-degree-at-most-one simplicial complex of the gear graph on 2n+1 vertices for n at least three; no higher thresholds, general Jahangir graphs, equivariant homotopy, or shellability are classified. The general cyclic all-n assertion relies on the written face-poset argument, with finite enumeration serving only as corroboration. Unindexed equivalent prior work cannot be excluded.
title: A parity law for gear-graph dissociation complexes
